Senses.Explanation: To summon the thief who ruins the house is to make a move that invites its own undoing. Chan critics apply the household image when a participant’s question, accommodation, or display gives the other party the opening that defeats it. Yangshan Huiji applies it to Huangbo’s exchange with Linji. Foxin Bencai places it beside leveling high and low. Lüyu Jiao applies it to the Buddha questioning two pig-carriers. Chijue Daochong says Yinshan summons the thief by answering Dongshan until he yields a confession.
